decision: Build a separate static website inside website
why: Keep website deployment independent of Electron and native builds

decision: Use original orange ASCII voice ribbons with the existing graphite and Manrope brand
why: Maple Research voice posters fit the product and the existing app artwork

decision: Capture current app renderer and build the early-access DMG
why: Visitors need real product proof and a real downloadable build
result: Renderer captures and desktop build passed

decision: Publish only binaries in a new public voco-releases repository
why: The application source is private and anonymous visitors cannot download its releases
result: Public early-access installer published; source visibility preserved

decision: Keep the project name voco and use getvoco.vercel.app
why: Vercel rejected voco.vercel.app because another project owns it

decision: Download the public installer anonymously and compare SHA-256
why: A release URL alone does not prove visitors get the intended file
result: Public download hash matches local verified DMG
